title: Pay superannuation for employees
what: Make superannuation contributions for each employee when qualifying earnings are paid, or pay the superannuation guarantee charge on any shortfall.

sources.title: Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Act 1992
sources.quote: Superannuation guarantee charge imposed on an employer’s superannuation guarantee shortfall for a QE day is payable by the employer.

sources.title: Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Act 1992
sources.quote: This Subdivision applies if an employer makes a payment of qualifying earnings to or for an employee on a particular day (the QE day).

sources.title: Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Act 1992
sources.quote: Superannuation guarantee charge imposed on an employer’s superannuation guarantee shortfall for a QE day is payable by the employer.

assessment.summary: Employers must pay a set share of each employee's ordinary earnings into a super fund each quarter.

marks.reason: Calculating, paying and reporting contributions for each employee every quarter.
